intro.text: In November 2024, the board of directors of Liberty Media Corporation (“Liberty Media”) authorized Liberty Media management to pursue a plan to split-off the Liberty Live Group (the “Split-Off”), which was completed on December 15, 2025. Immediately prior to effecting the Split-Off, Liberty Media’s subsidiary Quint, interests in certain private assets and $171.7 million of cash were reattributed from Liberty Media’s Formula One Group to its Liberty Live Group in exchange for interests in certain other private assets. Liberty Media effected the Split-Off through the redemption of Liberty Media’s Liberty Live common stock in exchange for Liberty Live Group common stock of a newly formed company called Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. (“Liberty Live” or the “Company”).
